scope: Host-only source-loading and archive integration tests. Transport responses and run metadata are synthetic; no device, UI, CI dispatch, method profiling or application acceptance.
newIntegrationCoverage: Real prepare and run_probe with only the ADB transport replaced by finite synthetic responses, then real archive loading the complete catalog from a temporary Git snapshot.
13 original preflight commands plus absence_ps, absence_input_method and absence_pid_after produce 16 commands with no profile_start/profile_stop and no native trace.
Empty primary PID remains COMMAND_FAILED_ime_pid / unverified after archive; all report and command bytes are copied unchanged; source job remains failure, recordedProbes stays zero.
A PID appearing in the final lookup leaves target null and profile unattempted; its output is preserved without promotion.
Forging report.status=recorded and clearing the primary reason is rejected by the fresh source validator before an archive directory is published.

compatibility.reportSourceScope: The new diagnostic scope is checked by the source-bound producer; archive does not replace or reinterpret original report fields.

reviewFindingResolved.issue: A process interruption after the primary PID result was saved but before the primary failure reason was saved would have made a valid unfinished receipt fail finalization.
reviewFindingResolved.resolution: Capture owner now admits only the no-diagnostic, unfinished preflight interval with no target or profiling state, and finalization fills the reason solely from the persisted exact primary empty/exit1 result. Commands are not retried or repaired.
reviewFindingResolved.coverage: Capture test test_interruption_between_primary_receipt_and_reason_is_preserved_and_finalized; archive suite rerun after this producer change. No additional mirrored archive test was needed.

limits: This validates source identity, receipt preservation and nonpromotion, not real API37 command output, IMMS binding or profiling support.
A transport exit-zero diagnostic result is not interpreted by the archive as a complete or semantically recognized process or input_method snapshot.
Synthetic fixture times remain the existing 2026-11-03 metadata interval; they are not represented as actual device execution dates.
